title: Payer Cost-Share and Liability Notice Schedule, Insulin Pump Program
content:
The Insulin Pump Program carries the following patient cost-share terms on each of its six tiers. The tier on a program is the payer program its coverage record belongs to, so the row that applies is read from the tier written on the customer's program.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply | Plan deductible applies | Crossover to secondary | Advance notice of financial liability |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | 100% (of the Larkfield cash price) | $0.00 | No | No | Not applicable |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | 0% | $35.00 | No | No | Plan member waiver |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | 20% | $0.00 | Yes | No | Plan member waiver |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | 20% | $0.00 | No | No | Organization determination required |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | 20% | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | 0% | $0.00 | No | No | Medicaid non-covered service agreement |

## Definitions of the columns

- **Coinsurance** — patient coinsurance as a percent of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible (self-pay tier: the share of the Larkfield cash price the customer pays); an integer percent.
- **Copay per 30-day supply** — the flat patient copay the plan applies per 30-day supply on a claim line, in US dollars ($0.00 means the plan applies no copay); it informs the expected patient responsibility the payer remittance confirms.
- **Plan deductible applies** — whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance; the deductible amount itself is the payer's and arrives on the remittance.
- **Crossover to secondary** — whether the patient responsibility left by the primary payer is automatically crossed over to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.
- **Advance notice of financial liability** — the advance notice of financial liability a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them. The forms are: not applicable, the plan member waiver, organization determination required, the CMS-R-131 Advance Beneficiary Notice, and the Medicaid non-covered service agreement.

## Reading the schedule

- On the Commercial HMO tier the customer's share of a covered 30-day supply is the $35.00 copay with 0% coinsurance and no deductible; on the Commercial PPO tier it is 20% coinsurance after the plan deductible, with no copay.
- The Original Medicare tier is the only tier on which the remaining patient responsibility crosses over to an in-effect secondary coverage before anything is statemented.
- On the Medicare Advantage tier no signed form appears in the notice column: the entry reads "organization determination required".

*Illustration (hypothetical figures only):* on a tier with 20% coinsurance and no copay, a claim line the payer allows at $200.00 with the deductible already met leaves a 20% share, $40.00, as the patient responsibility the remittance would be expected to confirm.
